🔥 Tired of fighting headless browser clusters, rate limits, and messy HTML just to feed your AI agents live web data?

Building autonomous agents or RAG pipelines shouldn't require maintaining fragile scraping scripts. Firecrawl transforms complex JavaScript sites, PDFs, and raw URLs into clean Markdown and structured JSON instantly. 

Stop wasting weeks on proxy rotation and structural parsing. Firecrawl handles dynamic rendering, anti-bot protections, and deep crawling out of the box so your agents get reliable, LLM-ready knowledge on demand.

Key Features Built for AI Engineers:
⚡ LLM-Ready Output: Instantly convert any URL or document into clean Markdown or structured JSON to minimize token usage.
🖱️ Interactive Web Actions: Let your agents scrape a page and execute browser commands like clicking, scrolling, and prompt-driven interactions.
🧠 Firecrawl Alexandria: Access over 550 specialized data providers—including company databases and research papers—through a single API or MCP client.
🗺️ Comprehensive Discovery: Seamlessly map websites, perform bulk batch scraping, and monitor content changes effortlessly.

Whether you are building an autonomous research assistant or piping real-time documentation into an LLM context window, Firecrawl is the essential modern knowledge infrastructure you need.

👉 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl

Tired of manual cross-posting and scattered analytics? 

Managing content across six or seven platforms simultaneously is a massive time sink for solo founders, indie hackers, and developer-content creators. 

Meet Maitian (https://github.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian), an open-source, self-hosted media management cockpit that automates your publishing workflow across Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, YouTube, and more without risking your account credentials.

Here is why you need it in your stack:

🚀 Hybrid Publishing Architecture: Uses a Chrome extension adapter via Chrome DevTools Protocol to auto-fill form data while leaving the final submit click safely to you, avoiding platform risk flags.
📊 Unified Analytics & Cohorts: Aggregates daily views, interactions, and follower counts, complete with automated 1st, 3rd, and 7th-day performance comparisons and weekly summaries.
🔒 Zero-Password Security: Leverages your existing logged-in browser session with local Node.js and SQLite persistence—no third-party SaaS vendor lock-in.
💬 Real-Time Feishu Integration: Pushes operational updates and metrics directly to your team chat or internal tools.

For developers, Maitian provides a clean blueprint for building local automation tools that bridge browser automation, local SQLite databases, and external webhooks. 

Check out the repo, star the project, and take control of your distribution pipeline today:
https://github.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian

In an era of bloated AI models, tiny-voca proves you can build an ultra-efficient, fully open 4.5-million-parameter text-to-speech engine that runs locally in browsers and on microcontrollers for under ten dollars in training costs. 🤯

Are you tired of relying on heavy cloud APIs and massive multi-billion parameter architectures just to convert text into audio? Say hello to tiny-voca. It is an ultra-lightweight English text-to-speech model featuring two distinct voices that runs entirely offline. 

Here is why developers and indie hackers are loving it:
• Featherlight Footprint: Only 4.5 million parameters and an 18 MB file size, complete with an integrated waveform generator.
• Blazing Fast: Achieves about 70x real-time inference speed on just four CPU threads. 
• Run Anywhere: Supports PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, ONNX Runtime Web, Node, Bun, and edge hardware like the ESP32-S3.
• Fully Open: Complete training recipe, dataset, and weights trained from scratch for under $10 in GPU time.

Whether you want to integrate zero-latency voice synthesis directly into client-side browser apps or deploy offline voice generation on resource-constrained microcontrollers without recurring API fees, tiny-voca has you covered. 

Check out the repo, drop a star, and start building locally today! 👇
https://github.com/n4ze3m/tiny-voca

Meet Allo, a meticulously crafted open-source variable typeface born from Inter, featuring custom axes for weight, optical size, and roundness. 🎨✨

Are you tired of settling for rigid, one-size-fits-all fonts that don't quite fit your modern UI or design system? Allo solves this by providing a free, open-source variable and static typeface optimized specifically for screens and digital products, successfully combining the technical reliability of modern UI fonts with a warm, geometric aesthetic. 

Here is why frontend developers, UI/UX designers, and tech enthusiasts are adding it to their stack:

🎛️ Three variable axes supporting dynamic tuning of Weight, Optical Size, and Roundness from sharp to friendly and round.
🔧 Extensive OpenType features including automatic arrow glyph generation, smart punctuation alignment, fractional numbers, and single-story character alternates.
📦 Comprehensive package providing both modern WOFF2 web fonts, static OTF files, and a dedicated npm package for web development pipelines.
⚙️ Fully reproducible build pipeline using Python, UFO sources, and AFDKO for automated font compilation and autohinting.

Drop Allo straight into your modern web applications via npm or self-hosted WOFF2 files, and use CSS font-variation-settings to programmatically animate or adapt typography states like roundness and weight dynamically on the fly! Perfect for clean SaaS dashboards, developer tools, and interactive web art where fonts respond to user input in real time. 🚀

Check out the repo, drop a star, and level up your typography today:
https://github.com/joshpuckett/allo
